bullets.title: Speedy 30W Charging
bullets.text: Experience cutting-edge 30W fast charging technology — twice as fast as 5V/3A chargers. Boost an iPhone 16 Pro Max to 50% in just 27 minutes, compared to an hour with traditional power banks.

bullets.title: Ready for Endless Use
bullets.text: Crafted for durability, the 5.4-inch built-in USB-C cable is tested to endure over 10,000 bends, ensuring it stands up to the rigors of everyday use.

bullets.title: Mighty Compact Power
bullets.text: This powerful 10,000mAh power bank is only 4.32 × 2.58 × 0.98″. It delivers up to 2 full charges for an iPhone 15, 1.94 charges for a Samsung S24, 2 charges for an iPhone 14 Pro, and 10 charges for AirPods Pro 2, making it perfect for travel. (Note: For iPhone 14 series and earlier, please use your own Lightning cable and connect it via the USB-A or USB-C port.)

bullets.title: 30W Bi-Directional Charging
bullets.text: Enjoy two-way fast charging, a feature found in many Anker power banks, with up to 30W output and 20W input. ( Note: Compatible with iPhone 15 Series, MacBook, Galaxy, iPad, Nintendo Switch, Steam Deck, and more.)

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo Power Bank (10K, 30W), 5.4-inch (13.7 cm) built-in USB-C cable, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Palm-Size, 15W Powerful Sound with BassUp 2.0
bullets.text: This ultra-compact portable speaker packs 15W powerful output and 92 dB peak loudness. BassUp 2.0 technology produces deep, punchy bass that defies its small size — no more sacrificing sound quality for portability.

bullets.title: 24-Hour Battery with Battery Display
bullets.text: This portable speaker delivers 24 hours playtime on a single charge — perfect for outdoor activities from sunrise to sunset. Plus, the real-time power display shows the exact battery level so you never get caught off guard by low power.

bullets.title: 2-in-1 Mount Strap for Versatile Outdoor Use
bullets.text: Dual-slot strap transforms between clip mode (attach to backpack/bike) and strap mode (for holding). Made of soft, tear-resistant silicone, it attaches securely and is a versatile option for any outdoor scenario.

bullets.title: IP68 Waterproof + 1-Meter Drop Protection
bullets.text: As a rugged waterproof speaker, Boom Go 3i is certified IP68 for complete dust and waterproof protection. Plus, it's been tested to withstand drops of up to 1 meter (3.28 ft). Take this durable waterproof speaker anywhere worry-free!

bullets.title: Lights That Move with Music + Preset EQ for Every Genre
bullets.text: Choose from 6 music-synced light modes and 8 ambient options to set the mood. Then dial in EQ presets — soundcore Boom Go 3i makes your portable bluetooth speaker sound right for hip-hop, pop, rock, and more.

bullets.title: Emergency Charging for Critical Moments
bullets.text: When you're out and can't plug in, the soundcore Boom Go 3i can help keep your phone going in a pinch — useful for maps, photos, and urgent calls, all from a portable bluetooth speaker built for the outdoors.

bullets.title: FROM ANKER — TRUSTED BY 80 MILLION+ USERS WORLDWIDE
bullets.text: Engineered by Anker, the world's #1 charging brand, soundcore Boom Go 3i is a rugged portable bluetooth speaker built for outdoor days — 15W BassUp 2.0 sound, up to 24H playtime with power level display, IP68 waterproof & dustproof with 1 m drop testing, plus music-synced lights and emergency phone charging.

bullets.title: Industry-First Floating Playback
bullets.text: Stays upright and sound-forward, even in waves. No distortion, no sinking just loud, clear audio for kayaking, pool parties, and every water adventure.

bullets.title: IP68 Waterproof and Dustproof
bullets.text: Built to survive the elements, this bluetooth speaker is fully waterproof and dust-tight. The ultimate outdoor speaker.

bullets.title: 5x Saltwater-Resistant & Ultra-Durable
bullets.text: Built for extremes 5x saltwater-resistant against sea, sweat, and spray. Drop-tested from 3.28 ft (1 m). Perfect for beach days and boat rides, with no rust or corrosion. Tougher than most rugged outdoor speakers.

bullets.title: Double the Bass with BassUp 2.0
bullets.text: Pushes 50W of powerful sound with bass as deep as 56Hz. BassUp 2.0 and DSP tech deliver punchy lows and crisp highs. Serious audio performance in a compact portable speaker.

bullets.title: Smart Features and 16H Playtime
bullets.text: Get 16 hours of nonstop play and full control via app. Comes with Voice Amplifier, Emergency Alarm, Buzz Clean, and a detachable strap for hands-free fun — everything you need in reliable outdoor speakers.

bullets.title: Compact Water‑Bottle Size for Portability
bullets.text: About the size of a water bottle, Boom 3i slips into your backpack, clips to your gear, and fits comfortably in one hand for grab‑and‑go adventures.

bullets.title: Guinness World Records
bullets.text: soundcore Liberty 5 Pro was certified by Guinness World Records in April 2026 as the "Highest speech quality score (G-MOS) for TWS earbuds (objective test)." Liberty 5 Pro Max features the same earbud units, delivering identical call performance.

bullets.title: AI Note-Taker & Subscription
bullets.text: Record OFFLINE meetings and easily transcribe them on demand to generate AI summaries with action items. Manage workflows on the go via the soundcore app (iOS/Android), or use the Web portal with the "Ask Anka" AI assistant for efficient desktop management. Standard subscription plans include Pro plan offers 1,200 minutes per month ($15.99/mo, $69.99/6-mo, or $99.99/yr) and Unlimited supports 24-hour all day transcription needs ($239.99/yr).You can also purchase additional minutes as needed.Liberty 5 Pro Max comes with a free Starter Plan 120 minutes of complimentary AI transcription per month for 24 months.

bullets.title: STRICT BUSINESS-GRADE PRIVACY
bullets.text: The trusted audio choice for professionals handling confidential information. Your conversations are secured with local AES-256 encryption. Without cloud sync enabled, temporary cloud files will be immediately deleted once you receive the audio transcription results, ensuring no audio and transcription content is retained. Built to the security standards with ISO 27001/27701, SOC 2 Type 1, HIPAA, EN 18031, EN 303645, and NIST IR 8425 compliance, the soundcore app and Liberty 5 Pro Max deliver uncompromising data privacy and peace of mind.

bullets.title: Effortless Screen Control
bullets.text: Features a large 1.78″ AMOLED display that lets you access the AI Voice Recorder, adjust ANC, and manage earbud settings — all from the screen. Add custom wallpapers to make your charging case truly yours.

bullets.title: Whisper-Clear Calls
bullets.text: Equipped with 10 sensors and the Thus AI Chip, enjoy crystal-clear calls in 100 dB+ noisy environments or even quiet rooms. Whisper, speak, or shout — your voice is always heard, anywhere you go.

bullets.title: Instant Pure Silence
bullets.text: 100% more effective noise cancellation than our previous flagship model. Powered by 8 sensors and the Thus AI Chip, the earbuds process 384K+ noise signals per second, blocking subway, office, or street chaos for instant silence.

bullets.title: Your Signature Sound
bullets.text: HearID 5.0 with personalized EQ and an AI Audio Enhancer deliver sound precisely tuned to your ears. No more compromises with generic, standard audio.

bullets.title: Lag-Free Voice Control
bullets.text: With 20 built-in commands, you can skip songs, take calls, and adjust the volume — offline processing ensures zero delay.

No drills, no damage, perfect for both indoors and out.
